item.title: St. Louis firefighters to install 1,000 smoke alarms this weekend
item.description: Firefighters in St. Louis are installing 1,000 smoke alarms this weekend as part of the "Smoke Alarm Blitz" initiative, in partnership with the Red Cross, to help prevent fire-related deaths.

item.title: St. Ignatius School in Marthasville closing after 150 years
item.description: St. Ignatius of Loyola School in Marthasville will close at the end of the current school year after more than 150 years in Warren County, Missouri, according to an announcement from the Archdiocese of St. Louis.

item.title: Body found in Spanish Lake front yard
item.description: SPANISH LAKE, Mo. -- A man was found dead in a Spanish Lake front yard Saturday. Police were seen on Larimore Road, near Larimore School. St. Louis County Police tell FOX 2 that they believe this was likely an overdose. No other information has been released.

item.title: Man critically injured in hit-and-run in north St. Louis
item.description: A man was critically injured after being struck by a vehicle that fled the scene Friday night in north St. Louis, police said.

item.title: Six Flags St. Louis fans react to sale of theme park
item.description: Fans of Six Flags St. Louis are sharing mixed emotions after learning the longtime theme park will be sold to a new owner.

item.title: Missouri senator drafts bill to boost college sports revenue
item.description: U.S. Senator Eric Schmitt, (R-Mo.) is proposing a bipartisan bill that looks to change how college football media rights are sold, a move he says could generate billions in new revenue for college sports.

item.title: Pam Hupp’s first planned court appearance in years takes a turn
item.description: After years of delays, the Pam Hupp murder case is finally nearing trial, with an expected start in August. Friday she was expected to make here first appearance in court in years, via video monitor.

item.title: Illinois State Police investigate East St. Louis Officer's death
item.description: EAST ST. LOUIS, Ill. -- An officer died Friday night in East St. Louis. Officer Rayvion Smith was found in the 200-block of Missouri Avenue. item.title: How soon could Cardinals' dynamic prospect Joshua Baez reach the majors?
item.description: Joshua Baez, a fast-rising outfield prospect in the Cardinals organization, emerged as a power-speed threat in the minors last season and has carried that momentum deep into spring training, raising hopes that he could soon be knocking on the door of a big-league promotion.

item.title: Metrolink riders unsettled after object shatters train window
item.description: Passengers on a MetroLink train in St. Louis experienced a shattered window, causing panic and confusion, though no shots were fired and authorities are investigating the incident as property damage.
